title: UserProfile
description: A BibleFi user profile representing an individual participant, church administrator, auditor, developer, or observer in the BibleFi ecosystem.

user_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this user profile (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the UserProfile schema used (e.g. '1.0.0').

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for this user.

role.description: The primary role of this user within the BibleFi ecosystem.

email.description: Contact email address for this user.

avatar_uri.description: URI pointing to the user's avatar image.

bio.description: Short biography or description provided by the user.

church_id.description: UUID of the church_record this user is associated with.

wallet_addresses.description: List of EVM wallet addresses associated with this user.

email_enabled.description: Whether to send email notifications to this user.

on_chain_alerts.description: Whether to notify the user of on-chain events affecting their wallets or church.

security_alerts.description: Whether to send security-related alerts (e.g. new security findings) to this user.

verified.description: Whether this user account has been verified by the BibleFi platform.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for filtering or categorisation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this user profile was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this user profile was last updated.
